title: News | Johnny Cardoso returns to boost Atletico ahead of Barcelona clash
text:
Vodacom Soccer | News | Johnny Cardoso returns to boost Atletico ahead of Barcelona clash Back Johnny Cardoso returns to boost Atletico ahead of Barcelona clash
 By  Rob Fleming La Liga   /  06 Nov 2026 Atletico Madrid have received a major boost ahead of Sunday's La Liga showdown with Barcelona after Johnny Cardoso returned to full training.
